The 808 rim-shot circuit in this port comes via 8W8 and X0X from the
Sonic Pi sc808 synth designs, adapted by Sam Aaron from Yoshinosuke
Horiuchi's SC-808. Sonic Pi's license identifies the sc808 adaptation
as MIT and credits Horiuchi's published permission for free use.

Sonic Pi license:
https://github.com/sonic-pi-net/sonic-pi/blob/c857ff77618485a8da56c334dd05a496be63292c/LICENSE.md#synth-designs

Sonic Pi sc808 design and original attribution:
https://github.com/sonic-pi-net/sonic-pi/blob/c857ff77618485a8da56c334dd05a496be63292c/etc/synthdefs/designs/supercollider/sc808.scd
